query: Can we commit to a small independent external validation pilot prior to public release; if yes, what sample size, vendor/site mix, and pass/fail performance targets should be used?

response.query: Can we commit to a small independent external validation pilot prior to public release; if yes, what sample size, vendor/site mix, and pass/fail performance targets should be used?
response.answer: Yes, a small independent external validation pilot is feasible. Aim for a sample size of 100-200 units, diverse vendor/site mix, and set pass/fail targets at 90% performance.

results.content: Therefore, all Member, Observer and Guest countries are asked to ensure that they: • sign and submit to ESS ERIC for counter-signature a DPA (this is a legal requirement, in accordance with applicable data protection law) before any data collection takes place, • field the complete ESS Round 12 questionnaires using the prescribed mixed-mode approach, • allocate cases to either face-to-face or self-completion at the sampling stage, with no switch of cases between approaches permitted, • deliver a Sample Design Data File (SDDF) which allows the calculation of inclusion probabilities (covering both data collection approaches), • make a complete delivery of ESS Round 12 data and documentation to the ESS Data Archive no later than the 2nd deposit delivery deadline (June 2026).

results.title: Changelog | Xperience by Kentico Documentation
results.content: * General – Custom JSON serialization options registered in the application’s service container using the `AddJsonOptions` method (e.g., on `AddLocalization`) could override the serialization settings required by the administration UI, causing certain features to malfunction or display admin UI content incorrectly. * Management MCP server – When using the Management MCP server to create a content type with a field referencing content items with a selected reusable field schema, the *Allowed reusable field schema* value was not set in the *Form component configuration* settings of the field. * Content types – When adding a new content type field with the *Content item* selector form component, the *Allowed content type* option could not be configured until the field was saved. * Admin UI customization – The `BarItemGroup` component (@kentico/xperience-admin-components) generated the “Each child in a list should have a unique ‘key’ prop” warning in the browser console, for example when using the field editor in the *Page types* application.
